# dsh-session-tree
An enhanced session tree for the DSH sidebar: the official `ui-workspace` tree plus tags, tag groupi
ng, drag-to-move across workspaces, and a delete action that can back sessions up first.
Forked from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` (0.1.7 tree) and shipped as a separate bundle so
the official package stays untouched.
## Requirements

| DSH | `0.2.1-rc.2` (developed and tested against it) |
| `@deepseek-ai/cordis` | `~4.0.5` |
| Reac

t | 18.2+ |
| Mode | Web UI (`web` or `desktop` profile) |
| **Companion** | **`dsh-session-manager`
— required for tags, moves and deletes** |
Earlier DSH releases are untested.

## The session-manager dependency
The browser half does not talk to the host over an IPC bridge. It calls a same-origin REST API under
`/api/dsh-session-manager/`:
| Call | Endpoint |

| Read all tags | `GET /api/dsh-session-manager/tags` |
| Write one session's tags | `PUT /api/dsh-s

ession-manager/tags` |
| Delete sessions | `POST /api/dsh-session-manager/sessions/delete` |
| Move
sessions | `POST /api/dsh-session-manager/sessions/move` |
Those four endpoints are served by **`dsh-session-manager`**. Without it, `tagRead()` catches the fa
ilure and returns `{}` — the tree still renders, but every tag is empty, writes silently do nothing,
and drag-to-move / delete fail. If tags look broken, check that `dsh-session-manager` is installed
and that its REST routes registered (`webServer` present).
## What it adds to the official tree
| Feature | Where |

| Tag chips on session rows | `sidebar.workspaces.session.row.action` |
| Tag / move / delete menu e

ntries | `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` |
| Grouping the tree by tag | the tree header |
| D

rag a session onto another workspace | the session row |
| Archive and unarchive | the row menu (una
rchive is the direction the GUI lacks) |
The tag data lives in `~/.dsh/session-tags.json`, written by `dsh-session-manager`, so tags survive
restarts and ride along when a session moves across workspaces.
The client polls for tag refreshes every 20 seconds. That is the interval a tag written from another
window shows up in this one.
## Implementation notes
- `lib/index.js` is a host-side placeholder — `export default function apply() {}`. The bundle patch

mounts both halves in one row, so the host half has to exist for the package to compose.
- `lib/cli
ent.js` (≈260 KB, 6015 lines) is the built fork. Its `sourceMappingURL` still points at `@deepseek-a
i/dsh-client-ui-workspace` and the CSS tag keeps `dataset.plugin = "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-works

pace"` — that is the upstream provenance, not a bug.
- `client.js` defines `class UiWorkspaceService
extends Service` and calls `super(ctx, "uiWorkspace")`. That is why the official row must be disabl

ed: two registrations of `uiWorkspace` cannot coexist.
- The package mounts into `sidebar.workspaces
.session.menu.item`, `sidebar.workspaces.session.row.action` and `shell.overlay`, and injects the of
ficial client packages it builds on (`dsh-api-remotes`, `dsh-api-session-controller`, `dsh-api-works
pace-controller`, `dsh-client-connection`, `dsh-client-locale`, `dsh-client-shortcuts`, `dsh-client-
ui-conversation`, `dsh-client-ui-layout`, `dsh-client-ui-renderer`, `dsh-client-ui-session`, `dsh-cl
`dsh-client-ui-layout`, `dsh-client-ui-renderer`, `dsh-client-ui-session`, `dsh-client-ui-sidebar`).
## Companion plugins

- `dsh-session-manager` — **required**: the REST API this tree reads and writes.
- `dsh-session-quer

y-vector` — semantic session search backend.
- `dsh-session-search` — in-conversation find bar.
- `d
sh-ui-reload` — one-click frontend reload button.
